cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd 'open up and let things flow'. So far, accurate. Close the kitchen stopcock first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You meant dinner conversation, not a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please read the whole phrase before correcting the forecast. The flow was explicit; we've reached that part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plumber says he'll have to open the ceiling to reach the leak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's 'open up'. Ask him for the exact section before he cuts, please. I'd like the work kept to the scope I predicted.
